title: Norwegian Pancakes
description: A traditional Norwegian recipe for delicious pancakes, perfect for a cold winter morning.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, water, eggs, and mix until smooth.
Add the zesty and bouncy if using, and stir until well combined.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings.
